response.rationale: Both Malay forms accurately express exchanging one currency for another. “Penukaran mata uang” is appropriate in Indonesian, while “pertukaran mata wang” is well-established in Malaysian Malay. The distinction is a national lexical preference, not a strict exclusive contrast. No false-friend contrast is applicable.
